logs_misrepresent_sender.note: A flagged comparison rescales a quantity by a literal to express a formula the report itself states across units. The compared symbols were declared with one shared raw unit, replacing the report mixed-unit arithmetic; and the scaling constant must be stated by the cited statement itself. Verify the encoding or record the relation in unresolved. This review never rewrites or rejects the plan.
